'''Rand ''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], where he had to make a deal with an Imperial to save his life.<ref name="TOR" />
